wish: someone should make a chess variant where you only see opposing pieces that threaten or are threatened
spec:
Two-player pass-and-play chess with full legal moves, castling, en passant, check and mate.
Tap a piece, tap a dot; each side sees only enemy pieces that attack or are attacked by its own, and a hand-off screen hides the board between turns.
No computer opponent, no clock, no undo, promotion is always a queen.
notes: Promotion is automatic queen. State is kept in localStorage.
